1479-2841-4677-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-4677-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3899-3951-4875-5703.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3899-3951-4875-5703.description:

Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.

Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3330-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.

When Ka-Zar of the Savage Land dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ka-Zar of the Savage Land from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

5231-6761-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Scouring Swarm trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Scouring Swarm trigger, untapping it and creating a creature token.
Repeat.
5231-6761-7084.notes: If you have seven or more land cards in your graveyard, this combo can create infinite creature tokens if you start it with two or more Scouring Swarms.

Repeat.

Blasting Station triggers once for each creature that enters under your control.
Resolve a Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature if desired.
Repeat steps 7 and 8 once for each creature if desired.
Resolve all abilities from step 4, dealing 1 damage to any target for each one.
Repeat from 3.

2034-2082-4186.description:

Activate the Sliver by paying {2}, untapping it.

Satya triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of Medomai the Ageless, and causing you to get {E}{E}.

When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
